segments.oily: The great majority of reviewers with oily skin, several also blemish- or blackhead-prone, report the foam controls shine, unclogs pores, and calms breakouts without over-drying; one reviewer with oily, non-sensitive skin is a clear exception, reporting it was too harsh and left her with persistent, painful breakouts and stripped skin over a month of use.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin say it cleans thoroughly without leaving an oily residue, though one reviewer with acne-prone combination skin reports breaking out immediately after switching to this formula and suspects it may not suit all skin types equally.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no breakouts or over-drying, including a long-time user in her 60s with sensitive, enlarged-pore skin who limits use to a few times a week to avoid drying it out too much.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 60s with enlarged pores finds the cleanser deep-cleans effectively but only suits her skin if she limits use to about three times a week.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who describe oily or shiny skin, including a T-zone-specific case, consistently report the foam cuts oil and shine and helps with blackheads and enlarged pores over time; a few say it can feel tight or taut afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with oily or blemish-prone skin, report fewer breakouts and clearer pores with regular use, some crediting it with clearing acne within weeks; a minority say it caused new or worse breakouts for them, including one who suspects the reformulated version does not suit all skin types equally.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out their skin and some describe it as hydrating; several others describe a tight, taut, or squeaky-clean feeling afterward, and one reports it overly stripped and irritated her skin over a month of use.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the cleanser calmed redness or irritation, including one who says her rosacea improved significantly within two weeks of starting it.
concerns.spots: One reviewer whose breakouts improved says she still needs a separate product to address the scarring the breakouts left behind.

extraits.titre: This is hard for me becau
extraits.texte: This is hard for me because I want to love this product so much, but it kind of tore my skin up. I love a deep cleansing foam and have used many but this one just overly strips my face to the point of discomfort and I dont have sensitive skin at all. It did in fact deep clean my pores but it did it in a way that my face was just constantly breaking out, and I have many face washes that cleanse my pores without heavy painful breakouts like this one gave me. I used it for about a month so that I would be past the purging faze that some face washes give you and it never stopped giving me painful acne and irritated stripped skin. As someone with oily skin that is never sensitive to products I can say this one is just too harsh.

I was so disappointed to learn that the White Lucent cleansing foam had been discontinued, but I tried this product instead after being told it was a "new and improved" version of it. Unfortunately I broke out immediately after making the switch. Maybe this has to do with my background as a mixed raced Middle-Eastern / Japanese woman with acne-prone combination skin, but I have also spoken to other customers (they identify as Asian, Latina and Southeast Asian) who also didn't have a good experience with this new line. In sum, I don't think Shiseido is considering all skin types when making new formulas. It seems as if this new formula only works for a specific type of skin.

Wanted to give this a try after I ran out of my holy grail cleanser. I think it does a great job of cleaning the skin but it left my skin feeling slightly stripped, like it was just a bit too harsh and drying. It didn't break me out or anything but just left a slight feeling of tightness.

extraits.titre: Great for oily skin, blackheads and big pores!
extraits.texte: If you're like me and you find yourself get oily and shiny before mid-day thwn this is the cleanser for you! I've been using this cleanser for 10 years and nothing can ever compare. It's especially amazing during the summer, but it's totally gentle enough to use during those winter months as well. It also does wonders for my blackheads on my nose and helps with my big pores. Ofcourse, like any other cleanser you need to make sure to use day and night! And then you will get the results desired.

At first I was wary because my skin is 60+ years old, is sensitive and has enlarged pores. Some products dry it out too much and make my skin look puckered. This deep cleansing foam is great if I don't use it too much. It really does a great job at cleansing, even after a day of wearing makeup. I'm restricting myself to 3 times a week and it works great for me that way.

I had rosacea and took medication for years and I tried this product and within two weeks my rosacea cleared up and now after using it for a couple months I no longer need my medication!!! I love this product thank you so much!! I also told my friends and family!!!
I have very oily skin, and with the use of facemask my skin started to breakout. This product is the saviour of my skin. Now i just need to find a product that helps with the scars.
